**Finding 1: ADDRESSED.**
- Fix: `plugins/ruflo-console/hooks/data/ap-envelope.ts` `isProtectedPath`, now at lines 30-34 (diff hunk @@ -21,21 +21,22). It lower-cases the path only when `isWindowsPath(path)` is true, before the slash and dot normalisation. `PROTECTED_DIRS` is already lower-case, so a lower-cased `flat` is enough. The `endsWith('/.claude-flow')` check also runs on the lower-cased path, so `C:/proj/.Claude-Flow` is caught.
- Import: `isWindowsPath` is added to the import from `./paths`. I confirmed it is exported at `paths.ts:11` as `DRIVE.test(p) || UNC.test(p)`.
- Reach: the validator call site (`ap-envelope.ts:124`) and `pathAllowed` (`ap-envelope.ts:339`) both go through `isProtectedPath`, so one change covers both.
- POSIX unchanged: a non-Windows path takes the ternary's else branch, so it reaches the same replace chain as before, with the same case-sensitive matching.
- Tests: `tests/paths.spec.ts:39-53` adds two tests.
  - The first checks `.Claude-Flow/Console`, `.CLAUDE-FLOW/protector-mod`, the lowercase form and the bare `.Claude-Flow` as protected on `C:/`. It checks that `C:/proj/src/x` is not protected. It also pins POSIX `/proj/.Claude-Flow/Console/x` as not protected and the lowercase POSIX path as protected.
  - The second checks `validateEnvelope` rejects the differently-cased drive paths and accepts `C:/proj/src/x`.
- I did not run the tests, as instructed.

**New breakage in the fix diff:** none.

**Out-of-scope observations (to defer):**
- `isProtectedPath` does not convert `\` to `/`. A backslash path such as `C:\proj\.Claude-Flow\Console` would not match the protected folders if the validator ever lets backslash paths through. I did not check whether `ap-envelope.ts` rejects them around line 117.
- `pathAllowed` (`ap-envelope.ts:339`) still compares the allowed root with a case-sensitive `startsWith`. On Windows, `C:/Proj` and `c:/proj` would not match.
- `pathAllowed` splits on `/` only, so `..` written with backslashes on Windows is not caught.
